name: Micro drama
what: A 10-15 s scene with a conflict that turns on the product: a person is caught, judged, rejected or surprised, and the product flips it. Reads like a clip from a vertical drama series, not an ad.

beats.does: the conflict lands in the first frame: an accusation, a rejection, a reveal, a slap of a line
why it hurts: the problem the product solves, shown on the person, said in the customer's own words
the product enters and is used on camera; the other person reacts
the flip: the result, the other person's new reaction, one line that lands the claim

camera: phone-shot drama look: handheld two-shot, punch-ins on reactions, one close-up on the product in use
sound: spoken lines in the take's own voices; a tense sting under the hook
variation_axes: hook line and on-screen hook text
